description: 2.5D traversal of bounded authored neighbourhoods/institutions/sacred spaces
narrative_purpose: Grounds compassion as embodied presence in real places rather than menus
output_feedback: Character moves; diegetic hotspots highlight on proximity
fail_state: None (no game-over); blocked path is fail-forward
accessibility_concern: Reduced-motion mode; touch + keyboard + controller; no reliance on fast reflexes
source_or_adaptation_constraint: No open world (owner non-goal); locations bounded (10A)

description: Look closely at labour/food systems/architecture/social barriers to capture a direct-observation card
narrative_purpose: Makes 'labour visible behind wealth' and hunger visible as structure
output_feedback: Observation card added to Ledger; short caption
fail_state: Missing an observation = incomplete causal map (fail-forward)
accessibility_concern: Colour-independent highlight; screen-reader labels on hotspots
source_or_adaptation_constraint: 04H section 6; storyboard 'no fantasy glow'; evidence labels required

description: Hear testimony that can be allowed to complete or cut short; finishing matters
narrative_purpose: Pillar 2: listening before intervention; testimony ownership (FU-017/018)
player_input: Hold/confirm 'let it finish'; no skip reward
output_feedback: Testimony card; trust shift; cause unlocked only if finished
fail_state: Cutting short loses a cause and lowers witness trust (fail-forward)
accessibility_concern: Full dialogue history; adjustable text speed; no timed input
source_or_adaptation_constraint: FU-017/FU-018; 05B; do not make testimony skippable filler

narrative_purpose: Pillar 4: evidence before certainty; the epic's epistemology as play
player_input: Assign a card to a category
output_feedback: Correct restraint rewarded; acting on assumption-as-proof triggers correction
fail_state: Misclassification = worse outcome + explicit correction (never hard fail)
accessibility_concern: Categories icon+text (not colour only); difficulty setting simplifies category count
source_or_adaptation_constraint: 05B; PHL-02; 10A 'make one incomplete inference and accept correction'; not a quiz

description: Assemble observations+testimony into material AND institutional causes of a problem
narrative_purpose: Owner loop step 5; separates symptom from structural cause
player_input: Link cards into a cause graph
output_feedback: Cause graph reveals binding constraints for intervention
fail_state: Incomplete map = intervention addresses symptom only (fail-forward)
accessibility_concern: Node/edge graph needs text-list alternative for screen readers
source_or_adaptation_constraint: 10A 'material and institutional causes'; must include institutional not just logistical

description: Per-person/per-institution relationship state governing testimony offered and interventions permitted; NOT a morality score
narrative_purpose: Consequences via trust/access/witness-safety instead of good-vs-evil
output_feedback: NPC behaviour changes; new testimony or obstruction; witness safety state
fail_state: Low trust closes options but never ends the game
accessibility_concern: Surfaced via behaviour+journal text (no colour-only bars)
source_or_adaptation_constraint: Owner: no karma points/no good-evil meter; SEQ-06 witness safety

description: Bowl gives infinite food; player arranges <=5 placeable actions (line/water/hands/animal-edge/level-serving) to solve human+institutional constraints
narrative_purpose: Core thesis: bowl removes one scarcity and reveals the system
player_input: Place/assign diegetic actions in the scene
output_feedback: Crowd/behaviour changes; reach & dignity read from bodies; 'system forms'
fail_state: Serve-only leaves visible unmet need; scene does not clear (partial success)
accessibility_concern: Must avoid spreadsheet; spatial not menu; difficulty reduces constraint count
source_or_adaptation_constraint: AD-0139; 04H section 6; RISK-011; food-vessel-and-service-workflow.md; NOT one-button

description: Serve at a person's level and ask what they need; satiety-with-dignity feedback
narrative_purpose: Primary emotional payoff; recipients as agents not devotional crowd
output_feedback: Body relaxes; 'Enough'; onward information offered if dignity high
fail_state: Herded/undignified serving withholds trust and onward info
accessibility_concern: Non-musical-dependent emotional cue; captions for breath/ambient
source_or_adaptation_constraint: FU-023; AD-0138; recipient dignity rule; not comic/miraculous theatre

description: Short controllable vignette in another character's past that changes the present decision
narrative_purpose: Branch-story rule: answer a present question and return changed
player_input: Constrained subset of core verbs in a memory frame
output_feedback: Unlocks a lesson/mandate in the present; memory-frame visual border
accessibility_concern: Clear memory-frame signposting for cognitive accessibility
source_or_adaptation_constraint: 10A branch rule; 04H (Aputhiran); AD-0141 self-starvation stays tragic (not played)

description: Change how an institution treats people (open rooms, hand over authority, make reform legible/durable)
narrative_purpose: Nonviolent power reorganisation; sustainability of care
player_input: Open/convert space; choose a local custodian; optional records action
output_feedback: Institution state changes; custodian persists; reform may later be reversed
fail_state: Reform left personal/undocumented = decorative charity; may not survive
accessibility_concern: Custodian-choice UI text-first; avoid overwhelming options
source_or_adaptation_constraint: FU-024; EV-0091; RISK-013; VENPA-USE-021/022/023 are PROPOSED not approved

description: Multi-axis snapshot of short- and long-term effects after Manimekalai acts/leaves; never summed
narrative_purpose: Owner loop step 8; 'what happens after she leaves'
fail_state: No lose-state; poor aftermath persists into epilogue
accessibility_concern: Axes as labelled text+icon (no colour-only); readable at large text sizes
source_or_adaptation_constraint: Owner: no karma meter; 05 consequence axes

description: Reflect on and record what remains unresolved after a scene/chapter
narrative_purpose: Ending as commitment not perfection; values honest over optimised play
output_feedback: Journal entry persists; feeds final epilogue
accessibility_concern: Full text scaling; screen-reader friendly; optional narration

description: Tamil-first dialogue with English support; tap-a-term glossary carrying evidence labels and pronunciation
narrative_purpose: Tamil cultural specificity without false certainty
player_input: Toggle language; tap term for gloss
output_feedback: Bilingual text; glossary entry with [TEXT]/[INTERPRETATION] label
accessibility_concern: Core to accessibility; Tamil rendering must be correct; pronunciation help
source_or_adaptation_constraint: Tamil terminology register + cue policy (10G); label uncertainty; not a claim of certainty
